messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — aligning Dedicated roadmap for reserved pools / quota slabting / launch criteria. Need a short decision list today: pilot scope, burst behavior, autoscale gating, telemetry & billing outputs. Owners?

Sasha (Eng): quick Q — what's the primary customer ask that forces strict vs soft quota?

Priya (PM): Two asks: 1) FinReg customer needs committed capacity + 99th percentile latency guarantee; 2) Marketplace SaaS wants predictable monthly cost w/ clear overage billing. Both prefer different tradeoffs (low latency vs predictability).

Mike (SRE): constraints from infra: we need quota-mapper + export to billing pipeline before strict enforcement. Without billing mapping, customers will be unhappy with overage attribution. Also eviction/preempt needs eviction-window logic.

Jules (Product Ops): Here's a concise set of proposed launch criteria (must / should / nice):
- MUST: reserved pool config (name, commit_qps, burst_allowance, preempt_policy), basic soft-spill behavior, telemetry (per-pool tail latency, token usage), billing export.
- SHOULD: controlled preemption (tenant eviction window), SLA reporting, rollout canary for 3 customers.
- NICE: predictive autoscale suggestions, tenant smoothing, per-tenant burst credits UI.

Sasha (Eng): Agree. For pilot I recommend starting with soft quotas + explicit spillover to elastic pool (no hard eviction). This buys time to wire billing and monitor.

Mike (SRE): +1. Hard eviction increases blast radius. Proposed minimal infra tasks: 1) quota-mapper service (maps tenant->pool->billing code), 2) soft-spill runtime path (fast), 3) telemetry hooks (per-route token counters), 4) billing-export connector. Estimated 3 sprints.

Priya (PM): Proposed experiment plan:
- Pilot scope: soft quotas with spillover, 3 tenants (one FinReg, one SaaS, one internal), 4-week canary.
- Guardrails: p99 latency delta < 15% vs baseline, monthly cost variance < 10% from expectation, no >2 severity incidents.
- Metric hooks: per-pool p50/p90/p99, spill_count, tokens_billed, preempt_count.

Sasha (Eng): Example reserved pool config we'd use in pilot:
```
reserved_pool:
  name: silver-10k
  commit_qps: 50
  burst_allowance: 2x
  preempt_policy: soft-spill
  billing_code: ACCT-123-silver
```

Jules (Product Ops): Launch gating checklist (concrete):
- Billing export pipe validated end-to-end (:billing-bot: test run)
- Telemetry dashboards for pool + tenant
- Canaries passing 4 weeks
- Customer-facing SLA language drafted
- Support runbook and escalation matrix

Mike (SRE): Blockers: needs infra prioritization. If product owners want billing + strict quotas earlier, we need to reprioritize kernel work and preemption logic (adds ~2 sprints). Otherwise soft pilot fits current roadmap.

Priya (PM): Prioritization: rank by customer delta vs engineering cost. Immediate priority = pilot (soft quotas) because it unlocks predictable billing and low-risk rollout. High-effort item = strict preemption and per-tenant eviction windows (defer to Q3 unless a customer pays for it).

Sasha (Eng): Proposal for decision:
- Ship soft-quota pilot (Q2).
- Parallel infra work: start quota-mapper + billing-export (sprint 1-3).
- Evaluate strict eviction after 4-week canary and explicit customer asks (if FinReg signs commitment, escalate).

Jules (Product Ops): OPS action items: build canary matrix, create customer comms, and draft SLA wording.

Priya (PM): Owners and rough timelines:
- Sasha -> proto runtime soft-spill (2 sprints)
- Mike -> quota-mapper + billing-export (3 sprints)
- Jules -> canary plan + docs (1 sprint)
- Priya -> stakeholder comms + prioritization decisions (ongoing)

Priya (PM): Anyone object to that plan? If not, I'll put into roadmap and spin tickets.

Sasha (Eng): No objections. :thumbsup:

Mike (SRE): No objections. flagging infra capacity though.

Jules (Product Ops): no objections. Will prep canary doc by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for branch feature/soft-spill (build 3342) — status: succeeded.

Priya (PM): Great — I'll create the roadmap epic and link tickets. Action: Sasha/Mike/Jules to sync tomorrow 10am to align APIs and dashboards.

Sasha (Eng): ACK.

Mike (SRE): ACK.

Jules (Product Ops): ACK.
